title: NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework

controls.title: Collect and maintain provenance data (SBOM) for each release
controls.expected: an SBOM is generated for the artifact
controls.remediation: Generate an SBOM (dsecrat sbom) as a mandatory build step.

controls.title: Identify and confirm vulnerabilities in released software
controls.remediation: Upgrade or waive each matched CVE; gate the build on severity.

controls.title: Sign and verify artifacts to establish integrity/provenance
controls.expected: release artifacts are signed and verification is enforced
controls.remediation: Sign images (dsecrat sign) and enforce verification at admission.

controls.title: Acquire well-secured components (no embedded secrets)
controls.expected: no embedded credentials in the artifact
controls.remediation: Remove embedded secrets; rotate any exposed credential.
